samples.summary: packages/frontend/README.md still tells operators the backend 'must run with YORKIE_AUTH_WEBHOOK_ENFORCE=true' to gate version history, which this PR's own doc updates elsewhere (packages/backend/README.md, self-hosting.md) now say is not the requirement — enforcement is the default with the variable unset. This file was not touched by the PR, so it was left stale by the same default-flip the rest of the PR documents.
samples.evidence: "the backend must register `ListRevisions` / `GetRevision` / `RestoreRevision` on the Yorkie auth webhook and run with `YORKIE_AUTH_WEBHOOK_ENFORCE=true` (see `packages/backend/README.md`)" — contradicts the corrected semantics in packages/backend/README.md:101 ('Unset (the default) = enforce...') that this same PR just updated.
